reason: I know my regulars by name, I don't need a screen to tell me who came twice, and loyalty rewards are a chain thing. I already pay for Wox and a terminal, and my waiters and guests are fine with how we pay now.
objection: Another system for my staff to learn and another fee on every bill. My regulars don't need it, and the tourists will leave anyway, whatever reward I switch on.
would_change_my_mind: A restaurant like mine in Tbilisi showing me its Google and Tripadvisor reviews actually went up from tourists in summer, with a QR fee in writing lower than my card terminal's.
